name: Sources
description: The numbered list of sources a reply drew on, with title, site and a short excerpt. Each entry is where a Citation marker lands.

sources.description: The sources, in order. Their position is their number.

label.description: Heading and accessible name of the list.

keyboard: Tab: moves through the source links
A source entry takes programmatic focus when a Citation marker is followed
requirements: A labelled region containing an ordered list
Links to other sites open in a new tab and say so in words
The entry a marker jumps to is highlighted and focusable
screenReader: Announced as a region named "Sources" with a list of N items
Each entry reads its title, and the site below it

use_when: Under any reply that cites its sources
avoid_when: A list of search results the user chooses from: use a list or Table
anti_patterns: Showing a source list with no markers pointing to it
